interactive_stuff.config.menu.pack.shake: Scale totem, sculk, torch and mace shaking. 0% disables shake; 100% keeps the original strength. Physics sway is separate.
interactive_stuff.config.menu.pack.note_: Play notes when crouching on a redstone block or swinging at a target block while holding a note block.
interactive_stuff.config.menu.pack.show_: Show a book on top of held enchanting tables. Its animation has a separate switch.
interactive_stuff.config.menu.pack.physi: Let held maces sway with movement, looking around and falling. Disabled while Punchy is installed.
Let held item frames and glow item frames sway with movement and looking around. Keep their usual holding pose.
Let held paintings sway with movement and looking around. Keep their usual holding pose.
Let held hanging signs sway with movement and looking around. Keep their usual holding pose.
interactive_stuff.config.menu.pack.tint_: Use biome colors on held grass blocks and leaves. The dirt part of grass blocks stays untinted.
Use biome-colored leaves on this pack's held sapling models.
Use biome-colored water in held buckets; show an empty bucket underwater.
interactive_stuff.config.menu.pack.anima: Extend held pistons when falling or crouching on a redstone block, with matching sounds.
Move held chest lids as you rise or fall, including copper chests where available.
Show rotating loot inside held vaults and change the displayed item periodically.
Light up held redstone lamps when crouching on a redstone block.
Open the held table's book near bookshelves. When disabled, the visible book stays closed.
Activate held sculk sensors after nearby sounds or landings, with active models and sounds. Particle emission has a separate switch.
interactive_stuff.config.menu.pack.torch: Extinguish held torches and campfires underwater, with sound and shake; relight them when leaving the water.
interactive_stuff.config.menu.pack.parti: Emit glyphs above held enchanting tables. Book visibility and animation are controlled separately.
Emit bursts when held sculk sensors activate, including calibrated sensors. Sounds and animation are controlled separately.
Emit colored notes when crouching on a redstone block with a held note block. Sound is controlled separately.

Select a resource pack or section to reset.
interactive_stuff.config.menu.setting.ma: Show emitter origins as green (main hand) and orange (off hand) crosses.
Show model pivots and emitter origins through items. Turn off to let solid surfaces hide markers according to their actual position. Does not change emitted particles.
interactive_stuff.config.menu.setting.pi: Show model pivots as purple (main hand) and violet (off hand) diamonds. Independent of Vyn debug text.
